annotation.title_clean: Decision of the EEA Joint Committee No 264/2021 of 24 September 2021 amending Protocol 31 to the EEA Agreement, on cooperation in specific fields outside the four freedoms
annotation.title_en: Decision of the EEA Joint Committee No 264/2021 of 24 September 2021 amending Protocol 31 to the EEA Agreement, on cooperation in specific fields outside the four freedoms
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (EEA Section)
annotation.summary_en: EEA Joint Committee decision amending Protocol 31 to extend EEA cooperation to Regulation (EU) 2021/694 establishing the Digital Europe Programme, allowing EFTA State participation from 1 January 2021 and setting cost eligibility. No AI or robotics governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Regulation (EU) 2021/694 (Digital Europe Programme) to Article 2(5) of Protocol 31 to the EEA Agreement
EFTA States' participation applies from 1 January 2021
Costs of actions starting after 1 January 2021 may be eligible if the Decision enters into force before the action ends
Enters into force the day after the last notification under Article 103(1)
